title: Ideal-power torsion preserves injective modules over a Noetherian ring
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $K\subseteq A$ be an ideal, and let $E$ be an injective $A$-module [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Then the $K$-power torsion submodule $\Gamma_K(E)=\{x\in E\mid \exists n\in\mathbf N,\ K^n x=0\}$ [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor] is injective as an $A$-module. Here $K^n x=0$ means $a x=0$ for every $a\in K^n$; no finite-generation hypothesis on $E$ is imposed.
